name: range keeps the notes between its bounds
about: range passes notes whose number is in lo..hi, both ends included, an open end reaching 0 or 127, and drops a note off outside the range the same as its note on.
notes: A note is kept when lo <= note <= hi. A missing lo is 0 and a missing hi is 127. Anything that is not a note passes.
l1 to low is lo 48 hi 59, both bounds. l2 to high is lo 60 and no hi, one open bound. Outputs follow link order, low before high.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 0: note 47 (2F) is below 48 and below 60. Nothing out.
t 1: note 48 (30), the low edge of l1, kept by low. NEGATIVE CONTROL: below 60, dropped by high.
t 2: note 59 (3B), the top edge of l1, kept by low. Dropped by high.
t 3: note 60 (3C). NEGATIVE CONTROL: above 59, dropped by low. The low edge of l2, kept by high.
t 4: note 127 (7F). Dropped by low. Kept by high, whose open top reaches 127.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 5: the note off of 47 (80 2F 00) is outside both ranges and dropped by both, as its note on was.
t 6: the note off of 48 reaches low only, where its note on went.
t 7: the note off of 60 reaches high only, where its note on went.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 8: B0 01 7F is a CC, and CC number 1 is not a pitch, so it passes both unchanged.
NEGATIVE CONTROL: l3 names neither bound and is refused bad-args.
